summary: Implemented ZestIcon/ZestIcon registry with 47 built-in SVG icons (shared style, aliases share instances), added 28 new semantic types to SemanticType union and defaults with specified variants/options, wired ZestButton defaults to library icons (replacing FA usage), exported ZestIcon/ZestIconProps/ZestIconSize from barrel, added icon styles, bumped version to 1.7.0, updated breaking changes. Finished the documentation and ZestIcon-test slice of the standardized-icons build. README now has a working semantic-types/ZestIcon example and Previous/Next links; features.md gained a Standardized Icons section and a 47-row built-in semantic-types table (one row per built-in name); api.md lists all 47 SemanticTypes and documents ZestIcon/ZestIconProps/ZestIconSize; examples.md replaces the now-built-in 'archive' custom-type example with 'publish', adds Recipe 7 for reusing standard icons, and uses ZestIcon; configuration.md and development.md use the new names and explain UI/zestIcons.tsx; breaking-changes.md keeps the 1.7.0 icon-change note. The ZestIcon size classes now resolve to the dedicated .zestIconSm/.zestIconMd/.zestIconLg rem-based CSS rules instead of the button size classes. Full suite passes (175 tests, 16 suites) and the Rollup build succeeds. Completed the slice-3 test suite for the exhaustive semantic types and standardized SVG icons. Added characterization and requirement tests for all 47 built-in types (28 new), providers/config precedence, defaults, ZestIcon reuse/performance, accessibility, security, and the existing-19 compatibility guard, plus a toggle/type-icon coexistence regression. The tests exposed one genuine R3 sizing gap: raw built-in SVG icons used directly as iconLeft were outside the .zestIcon wrapper, so they fell back to the browser's default SVG size. Added width/height 1em to the shared iconBaseProps in UI/zestIcons.tsx, which makes every built-in icon scale with the button's font size. Verified with npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, and the full Jest suite (18 suites, 221 tests) all passing.
